entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_01

entries.text: 你和乌栗的对战！\n像大火一样燃爆了！！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_01

entries.text: 乌栗从北上回来以后\n一场都没输过，\r\n你竟然把他打了个落花流水！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_02

entries.text: 难怪蓝莓联盟\n瞬间就被点燃了！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_03

entries.text: 然后！\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你当上冠军的话，\r\n乌栗就会降为四天王……[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_04

entries.text: 这样一来，很遗憾……四天王里\n最弱的我就要被挤出去了！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_05

entries.text: 这样啊！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 抱歉！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 哎呀～真的好难受啊～！\n但规矩就是规矩，没办法！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_06

entries.text: 而且，联盟社的气氛\n也变回了过去的样子，\r\n对我而言，这样更开心！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_07

entries.text: 这都是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你的功劳！\n我一直想开明火直说！\r\n谢谢你！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp01_08

entries.text: 喜欢！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 一般般
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 你喜欢啊！太好了！\c\n制作超辣的三明治的时候，\n你的确也完成得很轻松啊！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_01

entries.text: 一般般！？\c\n一般般还能顺利完成\n制作超辣的三明治，好厉害！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_01b

entries.text: 我当然喜欢烹饪！\n看我的煎锅就知道了吧！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_02

entries.text: 我家是开食堂的！\n将来我想继承家业！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_03

entries.text: 进入这所学园，也只是因为\n被校长挖来了而已！！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_04

entries.text: 所以，这次……\n乌栗和杜若前辈……[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_05

entries.text: 看到他们因为对战变得那么火热，\n烧得火星四溅，我很震惊。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_06

entries.text: 宝可梦对战真是厉害，\n竟然能让人变得如此火热。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_07

entries.text: 我觉得自己也可以试着\n把火力再～加大一点！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp02_08

entries.text: 据说我好像还能\n继续当四天王！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp03_01

entries.text: 好啊！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 为什么？
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 嗯，好……吗！？\n我也不太清楚！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp03_02

entries.text: 哎呀，连我自己\n也不太清楚！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp03_02b

entries.text: 因为乌栗休学了一阵子，\n还有各种事情……[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp03_03

entries.text: 所以蓝莓联盟暂停排名变动？\n……据说是这样的！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp03_04

entries.text: 紫竽前辈跟我解释过，\n但是太复杂，我忘了！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp03_05

entries.text: 能把各个广场当作据点\n是四天王的特权，非常方便，\r\n所以对我而言，真是走运啊～！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_sp03_06

entries.text: ……抱歉！在[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你面前，\n我就一五一十地把想法都说出来咯。[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_01_00

entries.text: 那啥那啥，我想和[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你\n像明火一样变得更要好！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_01_01

entries.text: 你不介意的话，\n就和我交换宝可梦吧！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_01_02

entries.text: 我燃起大火了！\n尝尝我的鸭嘴宝宝吧！\r\n你推荐哪个孩子呢？[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_01_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]，太燃了！\n好厉害，好开心！\r\n我一定会好～好珍惜它的！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_01_04

entries.text: 用[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n和我的鸭嘴宝宝交换，没错吧？[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_02_03

entries.text:
咦？宝可梦只有１只的话，
应该没法交换！\c
等你准备好２只以上
再燃烧起来也不迟！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_trade_03_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你来得正好！\n和我来场对战燃烧一下吧？[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_talkto_00

entries.text: 啧～！我差点熄火了！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_cancel_00

entries.text: 好咧～！\n我燃起中火了！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_battlestart_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n我只会双打对战，\r\n所以带２只以上的宝可梦来吧！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_battlestart_01

entries.text: 哇～！\n我燃起大火了～！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 好像比在蓝莓联盟对战的时候\n还要……更火热！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 这是我的一点心意，\n送给[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 用那个做一大～堆\n超辣的三明治吧！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_reward_00

entries.text: 燃烧殆尽，烤得焦黑！\n饭后还有奖品哦！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 下次让我\n再来一碗吧！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: 咦？似乎是\n我赢了，没错吧！？\r\n总之多谢款待！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
带着煎锅
就可以随时炒菜了！\c
就算有敌人来袭，
也能立刻保护自己！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_randomtalk_00

entries.text: 紫竽前辈\n有没有喜欢的人呢？\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你听说什么了吗？[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_randomtalk_01

entries.text: 超辣大神是\n掌管辛辣的神明，超厉害！\r\n是我想出来的！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_randomtalk_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]你给我的\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)]活泼又精神！\r\n我做的饭，它吃得超多哦！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_randomtalk_03

entries.text: 鸭嘴宝宝进化成鸭嘴火兽以后，\n让它带上熔岩增幅器再交换，\r\n就能进化成鸭嘴炎兽哦！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_honoo_randomtalk_04
